summary: This process describes how to create a daily timetable for classes, including defining lecture schedules, assigning subjects and teachers to specific time slots, and marking breaks.
steps: Select the "Class" for which the timetable is being created.
Define the "Lecture Number", "Start Time", and "End Time" for each lecture slot. The system will automatically suggest the start time for the next lecture based on the previous one's end time.
Click "Save Schedule" after defining all lecture timings.
For each day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday):
Click on a specific time slot.
Select the "Employee" (teacher) assigned to that subject.
Click "Push" to map the subject and teacher to the slot.
To define a break: Click on the desired time slot, then toggle the "Break" option to ON.
(Optional) To run two subjects simultaneously, use the "another option" (details not fully specified in transcript).
business_rules: Breaks can be defined within the schedule.
important_notes: The system helps by automatically setting the start time of the next lecture based on the previous one's end time.
Teachers must be mapped to subjects in "Teacher Mapping" to be available for selection here.
